subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
title: Healing the 10 Lepers
overview: Luke 17:11-19 tells how Jesus healed ten men with leprosy, and how only one returned to thank Him. In this sub-strand you will narrate that story, list ways to show gratitude to God and to people, and see the faith the ten men showed.

lessons.title: The ten men on the road
objectives: Say what happened to the ten men and what the one man did.
lessons.intro: Ten sick men stood at a distance and called to Jesus. They were not allowed to come close because of their disease. Jesus sent them to the priests, and they were healed as they went.
lessons.notes:
Read Luke 17:11-19 in turns. Narrate the story from the verses only.

Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem. He travelled along the border between Samaria and Galilee. As He was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met Him. They stood at a distance and called in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"

When Jesus saw them, He said, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." As they went, they were cleansed.

One of them, when he saw that he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice. He threw himself at Jesus' feet and thanked Him. He was a Samaritan.

Jesus asked, "Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine? Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?" Then He said to the man, "Rise and go; your faith has made you well."

### Words to understand
Leprosy was a skin disease. In that time, people with it stayed apart from others, which is why the ten men stood at a distance. Cleansed means they were healed. A Samaritan was a person from Samaria. Jesus called this man a foreigner because he was not from among the other people who might have been expected to return.

Keep the numbers clear: ten were healed, one returned. Do not say that the others became sick again. The passage says all ten were cleansed, and only one came back to praise God.

keyWords.meaning: a skin disease that, in Bible times, kept the sick person apart from other people
a person from Samaria; the one man who returned was a Samaritan

activity.title: Read, role-play and draw
steps: Role-play the healing of the ten lepers, including the one who returns.
Draw the ten lepers using a digital device or a pencil.
Narrate the story to a partner without looking at the Bible.

practice.question: Where was Jesus travelling, and how many men with leprosy met Him?
practice.answer: He was travelling along the border between Samaria and Galilee, on the way to Jerusalem. Ten men met Him.

practice.question: What did Jesus tell them to do, and when were they cleansed?
practice.answer: He told them to go and show themselves to the priests. They were cleansed as they went.

practice.question: How many returned to thank Jesus, and who was he?
practice.answer: One returned. He was a Samaritan.

summary: Ten men with leprosy called to Jesus from a distance.
As they went to the priests, they were cleansed.
Only one, a Samaritan, came back to praise God and thank Jesus.

lessons.title: Gratitude to God and faith
objectives: Outline ways of showing gratitude to God.
Explain how the ten lepers showed faith and how learners can trust God.
lessons.intro: All ten men were healed. Only one said thank you. Gratitude is not automatic. It is a choice to turn back and praise God.
lessons.notes:
Gratitude means being thankful and showing it. The one man praised God in a loud voice, fell at Jesus' feet, and thanked Him. Jesus noticed that the other nine did not return. Their healing was real, but their silence was not gratitude.

### Ways to show gratitude to God
- Say thank you in prayer every day.
- Praise Him aloud, as the Samaritan did.
- Sing songs of thanks at home and in church.
- Obey His word. Thanks that never obeys is thin.
- Write a thank-you note to God for the gift of life.
- Tell someone else what God has done.
- Use your health to help others.

### How the ten showed faith
They called Jesus "Master" and asked for pity. They obeyed His instruction to go to the priests before they could see the full result in the village. They were cleansed as they went. Jesus said to the one who returned, "Your faith has made you well." Faith here is trusting Jesus enough to call on Him and to go when He says go.

### Exercising faith
You exercise faith when you pray about sickness, school and family, and when you do the right thing while you wait. Share an instance when you prayed to God for healing. Appreciate the miracle of the ten by having faith in God yourself. Do not wait until everything is easy before you thank Him. The one man turned back as soon as he saw that he was healed.

keyWords.meaning: thankfulness that is shown in words and actions
telling how great God is, as the healed man did in a loud voice
trusting Jesus enough to obey Him

activity.title: A thank-you note to God
steps: In groups, list ways you express gratitude to God.
Tell how the ten lepers showed faith, and how the one man showed thanks.
Each learner writes a thank-you note to God for the gift of life.
Share an instance when you prayed for healing.
Sing a song about showing gratitude to God.

practice.question: How did the one man show gratitude?
practice.answer: He came back, praised God in a loud voice, threw himself at Jesus' feet and thanked Him.

practice.question: Give three ways you can show gratitude to God.
practice.answer: Any three: pray thanks, praise aloud, sing, obey, write a thank-you note, tell others, use your health to help.

practice.question: How did the ten men show faith?
practice.answer: They called on Jesus for pity and went to the priests as He said. They were cleansed as they went.

summary: Only one of the ten returned to thank Jesus.
Show gratitude by praise, prayer, obedience and a thank-you note.
The men showed faith by calling on Jesus and going as He commanded.

lessons.title: Saying thank you to people
objectives: Express gratitude to people who show kindness.
List polite ways to say thank you at home and at school.
lessons.intro: The nine men received a gift and walked on. The one man turned toward the giver. When a person is kind to you, gratitude means you do not walk on in silence.
lessons.notes:
Jesus asked, "Where are the other nine?" The question shows that thanks was the right response. We express gratitude to God first, and we also express it to people who help us.

### People who show kindness
A parent who cooks, a teacher who explains a sum again, a classmate who shares a pencil, a neighbour who helps you cross a busy place, a doctor who treats you: each one has given something. A quiet heart that never says thank you is like the nine who did not return.

### Ways to express gratitude to others
- Say "Thank you" clearly and look at the person.
- Write a short thank-you note.
- Tell a parent, so the kindness is known.
- Do a kindness in return when you can, without being forced.
- Do not grab a gift and run. Stop and speak.
- Thank people in front of others when that will encourage them, and thank them quietly when the help was private.
- Pray for the person who helped you.

Leprosy was a disease others feared to catch, so the ten men had been kept at a distance. Learners today should not fear or mock someone with a skin disease or any other illness. Be kind, keep clean, and let adults guide any health rules. Gratitude and kindness belong together. The Samaritan thanked Jesus. You thank the people God uses to help you.

Practise a sentence: "Thank you for sharing your rubber with me." Say it until it feels natural.

keyWords.meaning: to show what you feel in words or actions
a helpful action done for someone else

examples.problem: A classmate lends you a pen for the whole lesson. You return it without a word. What would gratitude look like?
steps: The one leper turned back to say thank you.
You should return the pen and say thank you.
examples.answer: Return the pen and say, "Thank you for lending me your pen."

activity.title: List and practise thanks
steps: List ways you express gratitude to other people.
Each learner names one person who has been kind this week and writes one thank-you sentence.
Role-play saying thank you for a shared pencil, for help with work, and for a meal at home.

practice.question: Why did Jesus ask, "Where are the other nine?"
practice.answer: Because all ten were cleansed, but only one returned to give thanks.

practice.question: Give two ways to express gratitude to a person who helps you.
practice.answer: Any two: say thank you, write a note, tell a parent, do a kindness in return, pray for the person.

practice.question: What should you say when a friend shares lunch with you?

summary: Jesus expected thanks from all ten, but only one returned.
Say thank you to people who show you kindness.
A thank-you can be spoken, written, or shown by a kind action in return.

quiz.question: The story of the ten lepers is in...
The men stood at a distance because...
options: they were afraid of a lion
quiz.explanation: Luke 17:12 says ten men who had leprosy stood at a distance.

quiz.question: Jesus told them to...
options: go and show themselves to the priests

quiz.question: They were cleansed...
quiz.explanation: Luke 17:14 says that as they went, they were cleansed.

quiz.question: How many came back to thank Jesus?
quiz.explanation: One Samaritan returned. Jesus asked where the other nine were.

quiz.question: The man who returned was...
quiz.explanation: Luke 17:16 says he was a Samaritan.

quiz.question: Which action shows gratitude to God?
options: Praising Him and writing a thank-you note
quiz.explanation: Praise, prayer and a thank-you note are ways of gratitude.

quiz.question: The ten men showed faith when they...
quiz.answer: Called on Jesus and went to the priests as He told them.
quiz.explanation: They obeyed before the story describes them arriving, and they were cleansed as they went.

quiz.question: Jesus said to the man who returned, "Your ______ has made you well."
quiz.explanation: Luke 17:19 says, "Your faith has made you well."

quiz.question: A friend shares a pencil. Gratitude to that person means...
quiz.explanation: Expressing gratitude includes a clear thank you.
